bounds: SentenceBoundary
Form C is the core offering filing for a Reg CF raise.
SentenceBoundary
It is not a prospectus reviewed and approved by the SEC. Use it as a structured map of the company, security, and risks.
SentenceBoundary
Start with the business description and team, then read the target and maximum raise, deadline, price or conversion terms, and intended use of proceeds.
SentenceBoundary
Check the capitalization section to see who already owns securities and whether other instruments may convert later.
SentenceBoundary
Review related-party transactions and the financial statements, paying attention to their date and whether they are certified, reviewed, or audited.
SentenceBoundary
Then read the risk factors and any attached exhibits, including the security agreement.
SentenceBoundary
Look for differences between the short pitch and the formal terms.
SentenceBoundary
A company could raise less than its maximum, or the use of proceeds could depend on the amount raised.
SentenceBoundary
The filing gives information to analyze; it does not certify that the business is sound.
SentenceBoundary
If a crucial term is unclear, pause and seek qualified advice before committing.
